resources.string: Nothing to play: no stream URL was provided.
Picture-in-picture is turned off for S Player in system settings.
A video player for Stremio that keeps playing in a floating picture-in-picture window, like Netflix and YouTube.

1. In Stremio, open Settings → Player and choose S Player as the external player. If Stremio asks which app to open a stream with, pick S Player.\n2. Start any movie or episode. It opens full screen in S Player.\n3. Swipe or press Home (or tap the picture-in-picture button) and the video keeps playing in a floating window. Drag it anywhere, tap it for controls, or drag it to the bottom of the screen to close it.
Enter a full URL, such as https://example.com/video.mp4
